purpose: Model transport and logistics as physical and economic networks of corridors, operators, capacity, throughput, nodes and dependencies.

entity.scope: publicly observable transport infrastructure and flows

evidence_model.rule: Separate physical capacity from observed throughput and planned capacity from commissioned capacity.

validation_rules: capacity must carry a unit and reference period
planned assets are not operational assets
throughput must identify direction or scope
border and jurisdiction claims need location evidence

implementation_notes.canonical_owner: Transport records describe network/corridor facts; individual infrastructure assets remain separate nodes.
implementation_notes.frontend: Prefer network summaries with drill-down to assets and countries.
known_traps: operator changes do not imply asset transfer
implementation_notes.research_task: Start with strategically important European corridors and identify their physical chokepoints and substitutes.
